subject: Roads Engineer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Walgett Shire Council People and Culture Team,

I'm applying for the Roads Engineer role that I saw on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, plus cost estimates and bills of quantities. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections and quality checks, tracking materials and writing progress reports.

Your advert describes road projects from investigation and scoping through to construction, maintenance and flood restoration across the Shire, which is the practical roads work I want to build my career on. I'm based in Melton VIC, open to discussing relocation to Walgett, and I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked on Australian road projects or with Transport for NSW standards yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.company_line: Walgett Shire Council serves a large regional area in north western New South Wales, and its roads connect the Shire's towns, villages, farms and essential services.
letter.subject: Roads Engineer
paragraphs: I am applying for the Roads Engineer role advertised on SEEK. Taking road, pavement and drainage works from investigation and scoping through to construction, and seeing that work make a practical difference to regional communities, is the career I want to build.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Austroads guides and Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date.

I hold an Australian driver's licence and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Walgett. I have not yet worked on Australian road projects or with Transport for NSW specifications, so I would start at junior level and learn quickly from your crews and coordinators.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
